categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies getblocktemplate caching inside BlockTemplateManager and src/rpc/mining.cpp.
categories.rationale: Moves getblocktemplate caching from function-local statics to BlockTemplateManager, eliminating global state and preventing raw CBlockIndex pointers from outliving ChainstateManager in multi-node tests. While it improves thread-safety annotations, adds unit tests, and enables #36357, it is an internal refactoring that does not change block template validity or performance.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Changes the internal template caching of getblocktemplate rather than RPC interfaces, transport, or argument parsing.
categories.rationale: The category excludes the underlying domain logic that an RPC exposes; moving template caching into the node context belongs strictly to mining.
